text:
Carmen (Marketing): Quick thread  Aurora benchmark story + 30s testimonial. Need quote + logo consent + legal ok for benchmark numbers. Publish target 2026-12-02. Can we lock by EOD tomorrow?
Leo (Growth): Will do 30s org + 15s ad + 6s bumper. UTM utm_campaign=aurora_benchmark_q4. Lead flow: HubSpot form -> SFDC campaign -> 7-day nurture.
Vera (CS): Customer draft includes exact p99 ms and a support ticket ID. They prefer to keep numbers but okay to anonymize ticket. Sending DocuSign for logo + quote + benchmark opt-in.
Marta (Legal): We need explicit consent to publish raw ms numbers. If they sign the benchmark opt-in, fine. Otherwise we must convert to relative phrasing (e.g., "~40% faster p99"). Also can't publish ticket IDs.
Carmen (Marketing): Okay, ask them to sign opt-in. Creative brief: 4s logo lockup, 20s quote highlight, 6s CTA. Subtitles burned EN + JP. Lower-third: "Aurora  Head of SRE, Kaito Tanaka" (if they want anonymized title we'll use "Senior SRE").
Vera (CS): DocuSign sent. ETA 5 hours. I asked them to confirm whether to publish ms numbers or percent.
ReleaseBot: Draft SFDC campaign created: "Aurora_Benchmark_Q4_2026". HubSpot nurture placeholder: "Aurora_Nurture_7d". Use /release finalize to activate.
Leo (Growth): Budget owner growth@redwood.com. Boost window 12/02-12/09. I'll add audience targets once creative exports are ready.
Vera (CS): Customer signed and opted to provide relative numbers only. Final quote: "After moving to Redwood Dedicated we reduced inference costs by ~37% and saw ~40% faster 99th percentile latency  Kaito Tanaka, Senior SRE, Aurora."
Marta (Legal): Approved language. No PII. :thumbsup: We can proceed with embargo if assets + signed consent are in place.
Carmen (Marketing): Great. Please upload assets and ReleaseBot run pre-publish checklist: render master, exports 30/15/6, burned subs EN/JP, CDN upload s3://redwood-marketing/aurora/, SFDC finalize, HubSpot activate, blog + social schedule, set embargo 2026-12-02T08:00:00Z.
ReleaseBot: Pre-publish checklist queued. Items created: aurora_master.mov, aurora_30s.mp4, aurora_15s.mp4, aurora_6s.mp4, en.srt, jp.srt, s3://redwood-marketing/aurora/, SFDC Aurora_Benchmark_Q4_2026, HubSpot Aurora_Nurture_7d.
Carmen (Marketing): Scheduling final review 2026-12-02 07:00Z. Everyone please mark calendar. Closing thread  post asset links when uploaded. :rocket:
